The specific black/gold closed-helmet variant remains recognizable; no silver figure, exposed head or parasite added.

The farther anatomical LEFT arm extends toward the hand closer to the weapon head. These two roles are reversed relative to the qualified source and recorded prompt, which require RIGHT forward and LEFT rear. Two attached hands are present, but correct anatomy count does not resolve this source-specific grip inversion.

A second sharp conical point has been added at the rear butt on screen left; this is unsupported by the reviewed source and differs from its plain/blunt rear endpoint. Both the grip and rear weapon endpoint need correction.

visual_checks.asymmetry: The hand ownership is reversed; the image cannot qualify as the source-preserving opposite view even though its costume, direction and silhouette are otherwise coherent.
